title: Vietnam Elections — shared definitions
description: Reusable definitions for the NA15-2021 export schemas. All four schema files belong in the same directory so relative $ref resolves.

dateOrNull.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) or null when the source does not state one

cycleId.description: Per-cycle export; this set covers the 15th National Assembly (2021)

statusValue.description: not_confirmed covers an elected candidate whose credentials were not validated; a record may carry both 'won' and 'not_confirmed'

docType.description: Add new media types here deliberately; an unknown value should fail validation rather than pass silently

termsStatus.description: Rights/licensing posture of the underlying source document

sourceRef.description: Lightweight per-field citation attached to records and sub-records

field.description: Which field of the parent record this source backs

documentRef.description: Full document record, with rights metadata. Used at results.source and inside annotations.

annotation.description: A status claim with its derivation and provenance. This is your reification layer: 'won' is a claim, not a raw fact.

reason.description: How the status was derived, e.g. 'Derived from order_in_unit vs seat_count'
